projectHygieneDefect.severity: process defect - report, do not file as a contract finding
projectHygieneDefect.statement: registered-projects.json advertises a knownIssuesFile that does not exist. Every audit of this project since 2026-01-09 has therefore run with a phantom suppression list: either the file was deleted/never committed, or the path is wrong. The practical consequence is asymmetric and worth stating plainly - it costs recall nothing (we suppress nothing) but it means the project has no working channel for telling the audit 'we already know about X', so genuinely-known issues will keep being re-filed and consuming triage.
recommendedAction: Either restore/commit lib/phoenix-phase-2-staging/known-issues.md, or correct knownIssuesFile to the real location (sibling projects point knownIssuesPath at lib/<project>/CLAUDE.md).
Re-extract the 11 entries from the corrected source and refresh knownIssuesExtractedAt. Until re-extracted, the cached 11 remain non-authoritative.
Do not silently delete the cached 11 - they may encode real owner decisions whose only record is that cache.
